-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def pbMessage : PbType GF :=
  { ty := raftpb.Message.ty, M := MsgSt, ro := fun l st => msgOwn l DFrac.discard st, ro_persistent := ⋯,
    marshals := MsgMarshals, wire := MsgWireOk,
    eqv := fun st st' => wireOf st = wireOf st' ∧ (st.resps = [] → st'.resps = []),
    blank := fun l => typedPointsto l (zero_val raftpb.Message) (DFrac.own 1),
    dec := fun l st => msgPtsC l (DFrac.own 1) (DFrac.own 1) true st }

def MsgWireOk (st : MsgSt) (bs : List w8) : Prop :=
  MsgMarshals st ∧ msgDecode bs = some (wireOf st)

theorem pbEntry_blank (l : Loc) : pbEntry.blank l = typedPointsto l (zero_val raftpb.Entry)
    (DFrac.own 1)

theorem pbEntry_dec (l : Loc) (e : EntryM) : pbEntry.dec l e = entRO l e

def EntWireOk (e : EntryM) (bs : List w8) : Prop :=
  entDecode bs = some e

theorem pbMessage_ro (l : Loc) (st : MsgSt) : pbMessage.ro l st = msgOwn l DFrac.discard st

def wireEq (st st' : MsgSt) : Prop :=
  st'.msg = st.msg ∧ st'.ents = st.ents ∧ st'.snap = st.snap ∧ st'.ctx = st.ctx

def (sealed) entDecode (bs : List w8) : Option EntryM

theorem pbEntry_M : pbEntry.M = EntryM

def pbEntry : PbType GF :=
  { ty := raftpb.Entry.ty, M := EntryM, ro := fun l e => entRO l e, ro_persistent := ⋯, marshals := fun x => True,
    wire := EntWireOk, eqv := fun e e' => e = e', blank := fun l => typedPointsto l (zero_val raftpb.Entry) (DFrac.own 1),
    dec := fun l e => entRO l e }

theorem pbEntry_ro (l : Loc) (e : EntryM) : pbEntry.ro l e = entRO l e

theorem pbEntry_wire : pbEntry.wire = EntWireOk

theorem pbMessage_dec (l : Loc) (st : MsgSt) : pbMessage.dec l st = msgPtsC l (DFrac.own 1)
    (DFrac.own 1) true st

def (sealed) msgDecode (bs : List w8) : Option MsgWire

theorem pbMessage_marshals : pbMessage.marshals = MsgMarshals

theorem pbMessage_wire_eq {st st' : MsgSt} {bs : List w8} (h : MsgWireOk st bs) (h' : MsgWireOk st'
    bs) : wireEq st st'

theorem pbMessage_ty : pbMessage.ty = raftpb.Message.ty

theorem pbMessage_eqv (st st' : MsgSt) : pbMessage.eqv st st' = (wireOf st = wireOf st' ∧ (st.resps
    = [] → st'.resps = []))

theorem EntWireOk.inj {e e' : EntryM} {bs : List w8} (h : EntWireOk e bs) (h' : EntWireOk e' bs) : e
    = e'

theorem pbEntry_ty : pbEntry.ty = raftpb.Entry.ty

theorem pbMessage_M : pbMessage.M = MsgSt

theorem pbMessage_blank (l : Loc) : pbMessage.blank l = typedPointsto l (zero_val raftpb.Message)
    (DFrac.own 1)

def wireOf (st : MsgSt) : MsgWire :=
  { msg := st.msg, ents := st.ents, snap := st.snap, ctx := st.ctx }

def MsgMarshals (st : MsgSt) : Prop :=
  st.resps = []

def instInhabitedMsgWire : Inhabited MsgWire :=
  { default := { msg := zero_val MessageM, ents := [], snap := none, ctx := [] } }

theorem pbEntry_marshals (e : EntryM) : pbEntry.marshals e = True

structure MsgWire : Type where
  msg : MessageM
  ents : List EntryM
  snap : Option SnapshotM
  ctx : List w8

theorem pbMessage_wire : pbMessage.wire = MsgWireOk
